Skeleton

The canonical loading floor. Bones are a tokenized --color-surface-sunken fill with a sheen sweep; the sweep is movement, so it pauses under reduced motion and forced colors. When data resolves, the real content fades in over --duration-crossfade — an opacity-only reveal that survives reduced motion (shortened to 120 ms) instead of cutting. The bones are aria-hidden; loading state is announced in a separate bilingual live region.

Skeleton bones

Bones are decorative (aria-hidden) on an aria-busy region.

Skeleton-to-content crossfade

Loading school… Cargando escuela…

The real card uses .hisd-skeleton-reveal; toggle reduced motion in your OS and the fade stays (shorter), it does not cut.

CLS-proof media frame

The frame reserves space with aspect-ratio + a dominant-color fill (zero layout shift); the image fades in on load. The LCP hero image instead sets loading="eager" fetchpriority="high".

Markup

<!-- Loading region: bones are aria-hidden; state lives in a live region -->
<div class="hisd-skeleton-group" aria-busy="true" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="hisd-skeleton hisd-skeleton--circle"></div>
  <div class="hisd-skeleton hisd-skeleton--title" style="inline-size:70%"></div>
  <div class="hisd-skeleton hisd-skeleton--text"></div>
  <div class="hisd-skeleton hisd-skeleton--text hisd-skeleton--short"></div>
</div>
<p class="visually-hidden" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading… Cargando…</p>

<!-- Real content: fades in on --duration-crossfade when data arrives -->
<div class="hisd-skeleton-reveal" data-loaded="false">…</div>

<!-- CLS-proof image: reserve the box, lazy-load, fade in on load -->
<!-- --hisd-media-placeholder: the image's dominant color (a build-time raw value), or a brand token -->
<div class="hisd-media-frame" style="--hisd-media-ratio: 4 / 3; --hisd-media-placeholder: var(--hisd-teal-100)">
  <img src="campus.avif" alt="HISD campus" width="800" height="600"
       loading="lazy" onload="this.dataset.loaded='true'">
</div>
<!-- LCP hero only: loading="eager" fetchpriority="high" -->
